unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Navigate negotiable-instrument issues by stage and legal version

payload.title: Build an instrument timeline before opening the statute
payload.core_explanation_md:
For an instrument problem, separate creation and parties, transfer or negotiation, presentment, dishonour and the particular remedy. Then consult the relevant provision in the version applicable to the facts. A bank collection-protection question is different from a drawer-prosecution question even when both concern the same cheque.

Use the appendix as a route into the full text, not as proof that the heading contains every condition. Record dates, holder status, crossing, payment or collection role, and the alleged defect. Presumptions and statutory protections need their own conditions; dishonour does not establish every civil and criminal consequence at once.

self_check.prompt_text: Why separate collection protection from drawer prosecution?
self_check.expected_takeaway: They concern different actors, conditions and remedies.
